info.title: Matomo Reporting API for Funnels plugin

get.description: Get summary metrics for a specific funnel like the number of conversions, the conversion rate, the number of entries etc.

parameters.name: idFunnel
parameters.description: Either idFunnel or idGoal has to be set

parameters.name: idGoal
parameters.description: Either idFunnel or idGoal has to be set. If goal given, will return the latest funnel for that goal.

get.description: Get funnel flow information. The returned datatable will include a row for each step within the funnel showing information like how many visits have entered or left the funnel at a certain position, how many have completed a certain step etc.

parameters.name: idFunnel
parameters.description: Either idFunnel or idGoal has to be set

parameters.name: idGoal
parameters.description: Either idFunnel or idGoal has to be set. If goal given, will return the latest funnel for that goal.

application/vnd.ms-excel.example:
label	step_nb_visits_actual	step_nb_entries	step_nb_exits	step_nb_visits	step_nb_skipped	step_nb_proceeded	step_nb_progressions	step_proceeded_rate	metadata_step_definition	metadata_step_position
Job board	0	0	0	0	0	0	0	0%	"Pattern: Path equals ""/jobs"""	1
Job view	0	0	0	0	0	0	0	0%	"Pattern: Path starts with ""/jobs/view/"""	2
New Job Application	0	0	0	0		0	0	0%	Converts goal: New Job Application	3

get.description: Get subTable funnel flow information. The returned datatable will include a row for proceeded, entries, and exists. If they have any values, they'll have a subTable of their own.

parameters.name: stepPosition
parameters.description: The step number to pull the data for.

parameters.name: idFunnel
parameters.description: Either idFunnel or idGoal has to be set

parameters.name: idGoal
parameters.description: Either idFunnel or idGoal has to be set. If goal given, will return the latest funnel for that goal.

application/vnd.ms-excel.example:
label	nb_hits	metadata_table_depth	metadata_step_position	metadata_sub_step_type
Entries	0	2	1	entry
Exits	0	2	1	exit

get.description: Get activated funnels for the current site.

parameters.name: idGoal
parameters.description: The ID of the goal to which the funnel is tied.

parameters.name: idFunnel
parameters.description: The ID of the funnel to delete.

get.description: Sets (overwrites) a funnel for this goal.

parameters.name: isActivated
parameters.description: Whether the funnel is activated. E.g. 0 or 1. As soon as a funnel is activated, a report will be generated for this funnel.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Definitions of each funnel step. If isActivated = true, there has to be at least one step. E.g. [{'position': 1, 'name': 'Step1', 'pattern_type': 'path_contains', 'pattern': 'path/dir', 'required': 0}]

200.description: The id of the created or updated funnel

get.description: Saves a funnel not tied to a goal.

parameters.name: idFunnel
parameters.description: ID of the funnel since we can't use the idSite and idGoal to identify it

parameters.name: funnelName
parameters.description: The name used to identify the funnel since it's not tied to a goal

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Definitions of each funnel step.Definitions of each funnel step. E.g. [{'position': 1, 'name': 'Step1', 'pattern_type': 'path_contains', 'pattern': 'path/dir', 'required': 0}]

200.description: The id of the created or updated funnel

get.description: Get a list of available pattern types that can be used to configure a funnel step.
Tests whether a URL matches any of the step patterns.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A value used to filter funnel flow by. E.g. URL, path, event category, event name, page title, goal ID, ...

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Definitions of funnel steps.
